question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 D 组：土耳其 vs 美国（2026-06-25），90 分钟三路赛果？
question_en: 2026 World Cup Group D: Türkiye vs United States (2026-06-25) — three-way result after 90 minutes?
one_liner_cn: 土耳其纸面实力明显占优，但美国东道主主场之利大幅缩窄差距，土耳其胜率约45%，平局加美国胜合计约55%，悬念不小。
one_liner_en: Türkiye holds a clear on-paper edge, but US host advantage narrows it substantially — roughly 45% Türkiye, with draw plus US win totaling about 55%.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差距 185 分：土耳其 1911（第13）vs 美国 1726（第39），纸面实力明显占优。
key_reasons.en: 185-point Elo gap: Türkiye 1911 (rank 13) vs USA 1726 (rank 39) — a clear on-paper edge.

key_reasons.cn: 美国为东道主，小组赛全部本土作战，本场在洛杉矶 SoFi 体育场，模型计入 +100 主场加成。
key_reasons.en: The US is a host nation playing all group matches at home; this one is at SoFi Stadium, Los Angeles, modeled with a +100 host bonus.

key_reasons.cn: 土耳其两名核心创造者带近期肌肉伤史（Çalhanoğlu 5 月比目鱼肌拉伤、Güler 4 月股二头肌伤），美国则伤缺主力后腰 Cardoso，双向伤情致净调整幅度很小。
key_reasons.en: Türkiye's two key creators carry recent muscle injuries (Çalhanoğlu soleus strain in May, Güler hamstring in April), while the US is missing starting DM Cardoso — offsetting injuries keep the net adjustment small.

method_note: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7) on eloratings.net ratings with +100 host bonus for USA home group match; p_stat 46.3/25.4/28.4 shifted by a bounded evidence-based adjustment of 1.3pp total (Türkiye creator injury history vs offsetting US absences). Market-blind: no betting or prediction-market data consulted.
